svg.text: What data goes in, how it is processed and modelled, and which results it produces. Arrows run left to right; dashed arrows are estimates fed back into earlier stages.

g.title: data.py → country-year panel: ~200 countries, 1850-2025: economy, demography, regime, conflict, crises, events, climate

interstate.build → dyad-years: every pair of states from 1850: power, distance, alliances, rivalry, alignment, events, regime

migration.py: refugee flows and host shares
dynamics.py: slow variables (debt, education, age, urban…) and party systems
